mapper.sql: id, username, display_name, email, password_hash, status, must_change_password, last_login_at, created_at

where.if: username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

mapper.select: SELECT FROM admin_user ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM admin_user WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_user (username, display_name, email, password_hash, status, must_change_password, created_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{displayName}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, 'ACTIVE', 1, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_user SET display_name = #{displayName}, email = #{email} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE admin_user SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE admin_user SET password_hash = #{hash}, must_change_password = #{mustChange}, failed_count = 0, locked_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE admin_session SET revoked_at = #{now} WHERE admin_id = #{adminId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT role_id FROM admin_user_role WHERE admin_id = #{adminId} ORDER BY role_id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO admin_user_role (admin_id, role_id) VALUES (#{adminId}, #{roleId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM admin_user u JOIN admin_user_role ur ON ur.admin_id = u.id JOIN admin_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.code = 'super_admin'
mapper.sql: id, code, name_zh, name_en, description, built_in
mapper.select: SELECT FROM admin_role ORDER BY id
SELECT permission FROM admin_role_permission WHERE role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY permission
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_user_role WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_role (code, name_zh, name_en, description, built_in) VALUES (#{code}, #{nameZh}, #{nameEn}, #{description}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_role SET name_zh = #{nameZh}, name_en = #{nameEn}, description = #{description} WHERE id = #{id} AND built_in = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM admin_role WHERE id = #{id} AND built_in = 0
mapper.select: SELECT menu_key, sort_order, visible FROM admin_menu
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_menu (menu_key, sort_order, visible) VALUES (#{key}, #{order}, #{visible}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sort_order = VALUES(sort_order), visible = VALUES(visible)
